room_rent.note: Base: Room Rent actuals up to SI. Optional Room Rent Type Option restricts to Single Private / Shared (premium-saver)

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay; 10% co-pay only if optional PPN-discount cover chosen and treatment taken outside network

sub_limits.note: Modern procedures, AYUSH, organ donor, mental illness, obesity, HIV/STD all at actuals up to SI

deductible.note: Per Claim Deductible available as optional premium-saver cover

ped_waiting.note: VERIFY exact base: PED waiting per Policy Schedule; reducible 2 years to 1 year via optional cover

specific_disease_waiting.note: Reducible to 1 year via optional cover

cumulative_bonus.note: No inbuilt cumulative bonus; optional Super Credit grows SI by fixed % each renewal. VERIFY base bonus

restoration.note: Super Reload inbuilt: 2X cover from day 1 on first claim, unlimited refill (up to Base SI) for subsequent claims

ambulance.note: Road ambulance domestic, actuals up to SI per hospitalisation

consumables.note: Claim Protect optional cover waives non-medical/non-payable items (all 4 lists of Annexure I)

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium, 30 days for other modes

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity excluded (Excl18); cumulative bonus & consumables only via optional covers; standard IRDAI exclusions

optional_riders.display: Super Credit, Cancer Booster, Chronic Care (Day-1), Claim Protect, PED/Specific waiting reduction, Critical Illness, Personal Accident, Room Rent Type, Per-Claim Deductible, PPN Discount
